narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Thirty one leaves one over in twos, threes and fives, so the answer is thirty one.
<bookmark mark='seven'/>In groups of seven, thirty one gives four groups and three left.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The last clue says none is left, so thirty one fails.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, divide ninety one by three, by two and by five. One is left each time.
<bookmark mark='seven'/>Then divide by seven, and nothing is left over. Every clue in the riddle holds.
